name: Lemon Cherry Belts Deli
description: Lineage: Rainbow Belts x Lemon Cherry Gelato Type: Indica-dominant hybrid Terpenes: Beta-Caryophyllene, Limonene, Myrcene Aroma: Sweet citrus, specifically notes of lemon and cherry, with a subtle earthy undertone Effects: Uplifting, relaxation, creative and focus Like your favorite candy—just grown up. This indica-dominant hybrid serves up sweet lemon zest and ripe cherry goodness with a creamy-smooth finish and a whisper of earthiness. The vibe kicks off bright and euphoric, boosting mood and focus, then eases into a calm, full-body chill that tells your nerves to clock out early. Powered by limonene, myrcene, and beta-caryophyllene, it’s the perfect treat for happy minds, creative sparks, and laid-back evenings.
